markets.title: New York City high at or above 80F?
markets.rules_text: Resolves YES if the observed daily high temperature in New York City is at least 80F.

markets.title: Will there be a tornado warning in Dallas?
markets.rules_text: Resolves YES if an official tornado warning is issued in Dallas.

markets.title: Chicago high at or above 70F?
markets.rules_text: Resolves YES if Chicago reaches at least 70F.
